page.overview:
Who is Riko Marr?

Riko Marr was a character in Death on the Titan.

Riko Marr was a deckhard on the Sand Titan. He had an antagonistic relationship with Chief Jarrick Thorne and was questioned by Captain Andohar Noah after Thorne died under suspiscious circumstances after a heated argument between them. Noah told Riko that he had searched his locker and discovered a coded message from the intelligence division of House Atreides that was addressed to Thorne. Riko insisted that he knew nothing of the message and was being framed, despite Noah's warning that the Spice Miner's Guild would allow the crew to kill him to satisfy their desire for revenge over Thorne's death.

However, another crew member came forward and stated that he had seen Riko enter the shigawire hut on the night of Thorne's murder. Riko then admitted to taking the message, but denied killing Thorne. Noah demanded to know why Riko had taken the message and he replied that he had hoped it contained incriminating information about Thorne. Noah ordered Riko to place his hand flat on the table, plunging a knife into it once he did. Overcome with pain, Riko confessed to the murder, stating that Tessa Lim had put him up to it.
